description:
Your service records, kept for as long as you own the car. On your phone, not on someone else's server.

Most maintenance apps ask you to make an account and sync it to a server. One broken login and years of history are gone. Glovebox has no account, no login, no server and no sync. Every oil change, tire swap and repair you enter stays on the device.

Nothing in Canada tells you when your car is due. There is no annual roadworthiness test for passenger cars in most of the country, so the only schedule you have is the one in the owner's manual and the one on the odometer. Glovebox keeps track of both.

WHAT IT DOES
- Log oil changes, tire rotations, brake work, filters, coolant, spark plugs, a safety inspection, or anything else you type in, on any number of vehicles
- Get a reminder when the next one is due, by date or by kilometres, whichever comes first
- See a vehicle's whole service history on one screen
- Export the lot to CSV whenever you want. Export is free and stays free

THE WINTER CHANGEOVER
Two sets of tires, twice a year, and the rotation, the balance and the alignment that come with them. Log the changeover the way you log an oil change, set the reminder by date, and it reaches you before the first freeze instead of after it.

WHY IT'S DIFFERENT
No account. No server. No sync to break. Your history cannot disappear, because there is nowhere for it to disappear from. It sits on the phone the way a paper logbook sits in the glovebox.

BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO KEEP THEIR CARS
- Unlimited service records across multiple vehicles
- Custom intervals for oil changes, tire rotations, brake jobs, air and cabin filters, coolant flushes, spark plugs and the rest
- Odometer based and date based due dates, whichever arrives first
- Plate renewal and safety inspection dates kept beside the mechanical work
- Dark, glare friendly screens, meant to be read in a driveway in February or under the lights at a dealership

WHEN YOU SELL IT
A private buyer asks two questions: what has been done, and when. A full log with dates and odometer readings answers both, and a safety inspection goes easier when you know what was replaced and at what reading. Proof of maintenance is worth more at resale than a clean dashboard.

WHO IT'S FOR
Daily drivers, weekend mechanics, people running a second car or a truck for work, and anyone who would rather have a searchable log than a folder of faded receipts.

Free for one vehicle. Glovebox Pro adds unlimited vehicles and custom service intervals. Export always stays free, for everyone.
